name: AB-001
summary: AB-001 (1-pentyl-3-(1-adamantoyl)indole) is a designer drug that was found as an ingredient in synthetic cannabis smoking blends in Ireland in 2010 and Hungary and Germany in 2011.

pharmacology.text: It is unclear who AB-001 was originally developed by, but it is structurally related to compounds such as AM-1248 and its corresponding 1-(tetrahydropyran-4-ylmethyl) analogue, which are known to be potent cannabinoid agonists with moderate to a high selectivity for CB2 over CB1.

summaryZh: AB-001（化學名：1-戊基-3-(1-金剛烷甲醯基)吲哚，1-pentyl-3-indole）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C24H31NO，屬於大麻素類狡詐家藥物，2010年在愛爾蘭，2011年在德國和匈牙利發現，結構上與AM-1248類似。
